note: One real Cline Pass SSE capture (deepseek-v4.1-flash), structural only: stream ids, session ids and the model's reasoning text were replaced with placeholders. Every event shape, field order and the trailing [DONE] are as received; the body was re-serialized as compact JSON, so escapes match what the proxy has to parse. Chunk sizes are the reader-sized splits used while capturing; the test also replays the same body one byte and seven bytes at a time.
